candidates.claim_text: # It Was Supposed to Be an AI Call, but a Human Appeared Behind the Scenes
issues: 見出しは人間がAIの電話の背後に現れたと述べるが、対象が一部の電話であることを限定しておらず、記事の比喩的な framing もLedgerの直接の記述ではない。
candidates.model_claim: It Was Supposed to Be an AI Call, but a Human Appeared Behind the Scenes

candidates.claim_text: Ask AI to make a haircut appointment.
issues: Museではなく一般的なAIに散髪の予約を依頼する描写であり、Ledgerの対象範囲を広げている。
candidates.model_claim: Ask AI to make a haircut appointment.

candidates.claim_text: Have it call a store, ask about an item’s stock, and get an estimate from a supplier.
issues: Museの電話機能ではなく、一般的なAIが店舗への在庫確認や業者からの見積もり取得を行うという形になっている。
candidates.model_claim: Have it call a store, ask about an item’s stock, and get an estimate from a supplier.

candidates.claim_text: The AI on your screen does all of it.
issues: AIが一連の作業をすべて実行すると断定しているが、Ledgerは一部の電話を人間が担当したと記録している。
candidates.model_claim: The AI on your screen does all of it.

candidates.claim_text: It is a very convenient future.
issues: サービスを「とても便利な未来」と評価する主張はLedgerに記載されていない。
candidates.model_claim: It is a very convenient future.

candidates.claim_text: But something unexpected happened behind the scenes.
issues: 「予想外のことが起きた」という評価・ framing はLedgerの事実として確認できない。
candidates.model_claim: But something unexpected happened behind the scenes.

candidates.claim_text: In some calls made through Muse, the caller was not AI but trained contract workers.
issues: 決定論検査で戻した: negation_polarity_mismatch

candidates.claim_text: Muse receives the request.
issues: Museが依頼を受け取るという個別の処理段階は、Ledgerに直接記載されていない。
candidates.model_claim: Muse receives the request.

candidates.claim_text: Up to that point, it is AI.
issues: 引き継ぎ前の作業がAIによって行われるという処理順序は、Ledgerに明記されていない。
candidates.model_claim: Up to that point, it is AI.

candidates.claim_text: It was as if a supporting actor, hard to spot in the script, had appeared in a play starring AI.
issues: 舞台の比喩と「台本の中で見つけにくい」という説明はLedgerにない。
candidates.model_claim: It was as if a supporting actor, hard to spot in the script, had appeared in a play starring AI.

candidates.claim_text: The fact that humans handled the calls was not, by itself, an immediate problem.
issues: 人間が電話を担当すること自体は問題ではないという評価はLedgerに記載されていない。
candidates.model_claim: The fact that humans handled the calls was not, by itself, an immediate problem.

candidates.claim_text: This is an important point.
issues: 「重要な点」という評価はLedgerに記載されていない。
candidates.model_claim: This is an important point.

candidates.claim_text: There was no confirmation that a large-scale information leak had taken place.
issues: 大規模な情報漏えいが確認されていないという主張は、Ledgerに明示されていない。Ledgerは懸念が示されたことを記録している。
candidates.model_claim: There was no confirmation that a large-scale information leak had taken place.

candidates.claim_text: But people did not know who was actually handling the work they had asked AI to do.
issues: 依頼者が実際の担当者を知らなかったという事実は、Ledgerに直接記載されていない。
candidates.model_claim: But people did not know who was actually handling the work they had asked AI to do.

candidates.claim_text: When that happens, a convenient service suddenly starts to look like a mystery story.
issues: サービスが謎めいて見えるという比喩的・評価的な主張はLedgerに記載されていない。
candidates.model_claim: When that happens, a convenient service suddenly starts to look like a mystery story.

candidates.claim_text: Meta executives admitted that starting the test without a proper explanation was a mistake.
issues: 誤りを認めた主体はLedgerでは部門の副社長とされているが、記事は「Meta executives」と複数・広範な主体にしている。
candidates.model_claim: Meta executives admitted that starting the test without a proper explanation was a mistake.

candidates.claim_text: They also temporarily put back the feature in which humans handled the calls.
issues: 「put back the feature」は機能を再び導入した意味にも取れ、Ledgerの「ロールバックした」と方向が一致するか不明確。
candidates.model_claim: They also temporarily put back the feature in which humans handled the calls.

candidates.claim_text: Even in an age when AI does our work, humans may step in to help.
issues: AIが仕事をする時代一般に、人間が補助に入る可能性を述べている。Ledgerが確認するのはMuseの特定のテストであり、一般化は支えられていない。
candidates.model_claim: Even in an age when AI does our work, humans may step in to help.

candidates.claim_text: But when they do, they should not appear secretly.
issues: 人間が秘密裏に現れるべきではないという規範的主張はLedgerに記載されていない。
candidates.model_claim: But when they do, they should not appear secretly.

candidates.claim_text: If they step onto the stage, they should say who they are first.
issues: 人間が電話の前に自ら名乗るべきだという規範はLedgerに記載されていない。
candidates.model_claim: If they step onto the stage, they should say who they are first.

candidates.claim_text: This incident showed that simple rule in a very memorable way.
issues: この出来事が特定の「単純なルール」を記憶に残る形で示したという評価・解釈はLedgerにない。
candidates.model_claim: This incident showed that simple rule in a very memorable way.

candidates.claim_text: Up to that point, it is AI.
issues: 人間への引き継ぎ前はすべてAIが作業していたと断定しているが、Ledgerはその段階の作業主体までは示していない。
candidates.model_claim: Up to that point, it is AI.

candidates.model_claim: The fact that humans handled the calls was not, by itself, an immediate problem.

candidates.model_claim: Also, their personal information might reach that person.

candidates.model_claim: But people did not know who was actually handling the work they had asked AI to do.

candidates.model_claim: Meta executives admitted that starting the test without a proper explanation was a mistake.

candidates.claim_text: They also temporarily put back the feature in which humans handled the calls.
issues: 「一時的に戻した」は機能を再導入した意味になり、Ledgerの「ロールバックした」と逆の操作を示している。
candidates.model_claim: They also temporarily put back the feature in which humans handled the calls.

candidates.claim_text: This incident showed that simple rule in a very memorable way.
issues: この事例が「人間は最初に名乗るべき」という規則を示したという結び付けは、Ledgerに記載されていない。
candidates.model_claim: This incident showed that simple rule in a very memorable way.
